name: @aivo/adaptive-baseline
description: Adaptive multimodal baseline assessment. Adjusts item difficulty in real time (1-PL Elo-style θ), supports visual / auditory / kinesthetic / reading-light item modalities, and emits a LearningProfile (modality fit, attention pattern, frustration tolerance, processing speed) alongside the grade-level placement so reading-difficulty / slow-processing / test-anxious learners are not disadvantaged.
